purpose: Categorize historical research results so future method comparisons do NOT rely on numbers produced by buggy or method-contaminated code.

categories.TRUST_AS_MECHANISTIC: Mechanistic/diagnostic results valid regardless of the train-loop bug (operator math, init behavior, ablation direction). Use only for direction/understanding, never as method comparison numbers.
categories.REQUIRES_RERUN: Numerical results produced by the historical main-branch code that is now known buggy or contaminated (stale ACLoss, C3 ensemble defaults, accumulation). Must be re-run on the restored baseline before use.
categories.INVALID_FOR_METHOD_COMPARISON: Results that cannot be compared against paper/baseline because they were generated by a different operator (corrected) or different protocol (batch/seed/verifier).
categories.CLOSED: TEST benchmark results are locked and must not be re-inspected during development.

entries.note: Root cause of historical 0.604 vs paper 0.577 drift. Verified by main:utils/utils.py::train (fixed on main) and test_grad_accum.py.
